[[Special Agent/Legends|Special Agent]] '''Mocen Gundross''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Gundross worked for [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] as an intelligence agent, but sold out to the Confederacy of Independent Systems and promised to give his new masters some Republic Intelligence agents to interrogate. He ordered a team of Republic Intelligence agents to place listening devices in a Separatist safehouse on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]], and secretly arranged for the agents to overhear that a shipment of weapons had been delivered to [[Mezhra Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] Clak'dor VII.

The agents informed Gundross of what they had learned and he ordered them to rendezvous with the Bith [[Ananah Kragana]], a fellow Republic defector, supposedly so that she could fly them to the station. However, in reality, he planned that she would simply capture the agents aboard her ship.
